! Command: show running-config
! device: eos-device1 (vEOS, EOS-4.24.6M)
!
! boot system flash:/vEOS-lab.swi
!
transceiver qsfp default-mode 4x10G
!
service routing protocols model ribd
!
hostname eos_device1
ip name-server vrf default 1.1.1.1
dns domain ansible.test
!
ntp server time.example.com
!
spanning-tree mode mstp
!
no aaa root
!
username admin privilege 15 role network-admin secret sha512 $6$Dq3slCu4l7sO/kMX$D97XDK3fxD9OYFyKcw7/YBZnaGtABzJSS8JAeqOYfibnCJcMns21U3MYCwX6LUO.NoZOx.zY4Sb7bD0Hq8ImQ0
username ansible privilege 15 secret sha512 $6$GHmU9z6zkcHNKird$qALeKFivOoZo8iJh4vcQ7e/3bA6i0QXn3.PaN8azDDsKKSy3EvWNIgbJ22fpKFPDP4iQ/Bn/Rq4baglerKetV0
username cisco privilege 15 secret sha512 $6$ILpOdCbi2gtCKWhQ$IfCQoOllqtQzxz69DcQ9GPosp9M7b8yy5Ryi0JhGIKr04SnxSy8eEWL.BDNPUaJyycgsogDq1VVYvLu4MDmwd1
username eos privilege 15 secret sha512 $6$bsE3TqKAs1or/d4o$KrCUDx.hnwNk0VIRQ.eWeGIYucXgDsHpJGZCsZVkTZ57Tv26eAT2/gCDJHwA1sYFRT96PXEhIbgZbEbJkJIDv.
username zuul privilege 15 nopassword
username zuul ssh-key ssh-rsa  zuul-executor
!
vrf instance blue_vrf
!
vrf instance red_vrf
!
interface Ethernet1
   description Management
   ip address 192.168.1.10/24
!
interface Ethernet2
   description Data
   ip address 10.0.0.10/24
!
interface Ethernet3
!
interface Ethernet4
!
interface Ethernet5
!
interface Ethernet6
!
interface Ethernet7
!
interface Ethernet8
!
interface Ethernet9
!
interface Ethernet10
!
interface Ethernet11
!
interface Ethernet12
!
interface Management1
   ip address dhcp
   dhcp client accept default-route
!
interface Vlan10
   vrf blue_vrf
!
interface Vlan20
   vrf red_vrf
!
ip routing
no ip routing vrf blue_vrf
no ip routing vrf red_vrf
!
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 172.16.16.1
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 192.168.1.1
ip route 10.0.0.0/8 10.1.1.1
ip route 10.1.1.2/32 172.16.16.1
ip route 10.10.0.0/16 172.16.16.1
!
router ospf 1
   router-id 1.1.1.1
   network 10.0.0.0/8 area 0.0.0.0
   max-lsa 12000
!
end
